responsibility: Declares the exported arm_mve::functions symbols for the base MVE intrinsic implementation set. It is the companion interface to arm-mve-builtins-base.cc, listing one extern const function_base * handle per intrinsic family so the table-building code can refer to concrete implementations without pulling in their class definitions. Its role is specifically to name and expose the available base-function objects, not to describe signatures or expansion mechanics.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the interface for the base builtin implementation set by declaring extern const function_base * symbols in arm_mve::functions. Unlike arm-mve-builtins-base.cc, it contains no implementation logic, and unlike arm-mve-builtins-base.def, it is not the registration table of intrinsic families, but the header other MVE builtin code includes to reference the concrete base handlers.
